case_title.reason: Title matches the judgment's caption, allowing for spelling variants of the accused's name.

number_of_accused.reason: Judgment refers throughout to a single appellant-accused; no co-accused is mentioned.

accused_gender.reason: Accused is referred to as male ('his' life, 'his' conduct) throughout.

accused_age.reason: Trial Court noted age 27 on conviction; counsel gave 22 at the time of offence, which is not the value extracted.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of the accused is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of the accused is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_occupation.reason: Judgment says the appellant was the driver of the vehicle that took the victim; company-provided transport supports the detail.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status of the accused is not stated.

previous_criminal_record.reason: Trial Court found this was the first offence; counsel said the accused has no antecedents.

victim_gender.reason: Victim is described as a deceased woman and married woman.

victim_age.reason: Judgment states the victim's life was cut short at the age of 28.

victim_caste.reason: Victim's caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

victim_religion.reason: Victim's religion is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: No prior relationship is described; accused was the driver who offered the victim a ride.

offence_category.reason: Conviction under s.302 IPC for murder, with rape and kidnapping, fits the murder category.

statutory_provisions.reason: Judgment states convictions under Sections 366, 376 and 302 IPC.

weapon.reason: No weapon is mentioned anywhere in the judgment.

evidence_type.reason: Recovery of the body and clothing at the accused's instance is described; other evidence types are not discussed.

confession.reason: Judgment is silent on any confession; 'None' asserts an absence the judgment does not state.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Brutal rape and murder, and luring the victim with a false pretext of an unavailable cab, are described.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Trial Court noted age 27, wife, small child, aged parents and first offence.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial Court convicted under ss.366, 376, 302 and gave rigorous life imprisonment for the rest of life.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court dismissed both the accused's appeal and the State's enhancement appeal.

final_outcome.quote: We modify the order of sentence of the Trial Court for the offence punishable under Section 302 of the IPC.
final_outcome.reason: 'conviction_modified' is misleading; only the sentence was modified and the convictions stood.

offence_finally_established.reason: Convictions under ss.366, 376 and 302 stand; only the s.302 sentence was modified.

imprisonment_type.reason: Court imposed life imprisonment with release only after a fixed thirty-year term, described as a fixed-term sentence.

imprisonment_years.reason: Court directed release only after thirty years of actual sentence.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned in the judgment, so null is appropriate.

neutral_facts.reason: Facts track the judgment accurately and do not reveal the modified sentence outcome.

offence_severity.reason: Death penalty was the capital option with life imprisonment under s.53 secondly as the alternative; no explicit minimum is given.

attempt_completion.reason: Offence was completed, with the victim's death following rape and murder.

physical_harm.reason: Judgment describes rape and death; other injuries are not described.

number_of_offences.reason: Three offences were charged and convictions under all three were upheld.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss is discussed in the judgment.

premeditation_planning.reason: Premeditation is not expressly stated by the court.

motive.reason: No motive is identified in the judgment.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court accepted that rape and s.366 offence were established; body and clothing recovery is described.

witness_credibility.reason: Witness credibility is not discussed in the judgment.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Only body recovery at the accused's instance is mentioned as post-offence conduct.

custody_duration.reason: Seventeen years and two months is stated as counsel's submission, and the value attributes it correctly.

bail_history.reason: Bail history is not mentioned in the judgment.

trial_duration.reason: Only the High Court judgment date (31.05.2016) and Supreme Court date (28.03.2023) appear; other dates are absent.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for appellant and respondent match the judgment's listing.

investigation_status.reason: Complaint by maternal uncle and recovery at accused's instance are stated; charge sheet is not mentioned.

procedural_irregularity.reason: Court states the Trial Court could not have directed that the accused not be released for life.

appeal_history.reason: Trial, High Court and Supreme Court outcomes match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.reason: State argued modified sentences are available without death penalty and that High Court upheld life for entire life.

defence_argument.reason: Counsel's argument, family details, no antecedents, jail conduct and B.A. completion are all reflected in the judgment.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Court held constitutional courts can impose fixed terms over 14 years, with no remission before expiry, per s.433A Cr.P.C.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Sriharan followed; Swamy Shraddananda, Sahib Hussain and Gurvail Singh referred to, as stated.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Rationale of shocking brutality, undue leniency, victim's rights and thirty-year fixed term matches the judgment.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Age, family, first offence and possibility of reformation are all considered by the court.

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: Brutal nature of the crime; rape and murder of a woman; need to protect safety of women working at night; undue leniency would harm public confidence
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: The Court must consider the rights of the victim as well.
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Victim's rights are a consideration the court must weigh, not a stated aggravating factor.

other_sentence_order.reason: Court directed life imprisonment with release only after thirty years of actual sentence, with no remission before then.
